## D — Accuracy and evidence notes: Impaired, distracted and drowsy driving
Every knowledge statement for Impaired, distracted and drowsy driving is tied to one physical page of the registered Delaware handbook snapshot. No outside legal explanation or inferred exception is added.
All BAC, penalty and IID tables are source-edition rules, not personalized legal or clinical advice. No safe driving delay is inferred from absorption examples or drink equivalents. Historical crash totals and image-only chart values are excluded.
The underage possession subsection and its exceptions cross a page boundary; the base penalties and continuation exceptions are separate page-bound facts. The IID and sanction tables preserve their distinct administrative versus court roles.
Open source limitation (verify DE-IMPAIRMENT-DRUG-SCOPE): The BAC discussion describes illicit or recreational drugs while the administrative-hearing passage uses a broader any-drug phrase; do not unify these as a blanket prescription-drug rule without issuer clarification.
Open source limitation (verify DE-IMPAIRMENT-SPAN): The underage possession exception continues onto the next physical page; its scope must remain paired with the base subsection when teaching or testing.
Source quality: official issuer PDF. Extraction is text only; graphical content does not become a fact unless its supporting meaning is stated in the text. Unknown exam metadata and market evidence remain typed debt.
